description: Figure 19 is a bar chart that illustrates the average probing accuracy of multilingual BERT models using different MLP variations. The chart has a vertical axis labeled "% point difference" with a scale ranging from -0.2 to 0.2, and a horizontal axis that lists different MLP variations: hidden[50, linear], hidden[100, linear], hidden[1000, ReLU], and hidden[50, ReLU]. There are two sets of bars for each MLP variation, representing two different BERT models: mBERT and XLM-R. The bars are color-coded, with mBERT in a lighter shade and XLM-R in a darker shade. The chart shows that the probing accuracy varies across different MLP variations and models, with some variations showing higher accuracy than others. The size of the hidden layers is indicated in square brackets next to the corresponding bars.
